title: HEMTT M978A4 fuel tanker
name: hemtt_m978a4
lede: The US Army's HEMTT M978A4 fuel servicing truck at 1:1 scale, outside only: the M977's cab, frame and 8×8 running gear (shared with `../hemtt-m977`) under a 2,500 US gallon tank with its catwalk, manholes and fold-down handrails, and the rear pump module with its hose reels, pump, filter-separator and meters behind four doors.
grid: Rear three-quarter view with the pump module's doors open
The tank's top: catwalk, handrails and manholes
The hose reels, pump and filter-separator
game_note: Textured, with the doors, pump doors, hose reels and every wheel and its steering its own node.
viewer_note: orbit round it, drive and steer it, open the cab and pump doors.
scale_intro: Built to Oshkosh's published M978A4 figures; `build.py` measures the finished geometry against them on every build, and the tank's shell holds 2,500 US gallons:
origin: on the ground, on the centreline, midway between the front and rear axle pairs
moving: spin about local X; + rolls forward (radius 0.62 m)
steer about local Y; + turns left. Full lock is the inner wheels' for the published 100 ft turning circle: 27° on the first axle, 21° on the second
the cab doors swing about `axis` on hinges on their outer skins (group `Cab doors`)
the pump module's rear doors swing out on hinges at its back corners and fold round flat against its sides (group `Pump rear doors`); its side doors lift on their tops (group `Pump side doors`)
turn about local X to pay the hose out
on its carrier behind the cab
head, blackout and tail lights; their lens materials `Light_White`, `Light_Amber` and `Light_Red` are emissive, so scale the emission to switch them
look: **Paint:** CARC green 383 with the tank's welded sheet seams and the cab's panels.
**Markings:** red FLAMMABLE placards with UN 1863, JP-8, CAPACITY 2500 GALLONS, NO SMOKING WITHIN 50 FEET, the registration and bumper codes.
**Weathering:** mud thrown up by every wheel, fuel stains running down from the manholes, dust and exhaust soot.
textures: Cab, doors, front end, engine bay, fuel tank and boxes
The tank, catwalk, manholes, pump module and its doors, rear end
Frame and running gear, tyres, hoses, extinguishers, steel
accuracy: **Published dimensions:** length, width, height over the spare tyre, wheelbase, track, the tyres, the tank's capacity, the 41° approach angle and the 100 ft turning circle (as the steering locks) all match.
**Estimated:** the tank's shape and length (sized to hold 2,500 gal), the pump module's layout and the fittings.
**Markings:** plausible but made up; the registration isn't a real truck's.
